name: Fleet Intelligence
description: Agent-first fleet analytics and routing. Explore dwell and congestion patterns, optimize multi-stop routes, compute drive-time isochrones, and analyze points of interest and retail catchments — all scoped to a selectable region and vehicle type.
capabilities: Analyze courier dwell time and congestion hotspots by region and vehicle type
Optimize multi-stop vehicle routes and compute drive-time isochrones
Find points of interest and estimate retail catchment areas
Switch the active region and vehicle context across dashboards and routing tools
sampleQuestions: Where are the worst dwell hotspots this week?
Show congestion by hour for the current region
Optimize a route for these 8 delivery stops
What is the 15-minute drive-time isochrone from the depot?
